response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg_loss_rate) AS average_team_loss_rate FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_avg_loss_rate FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 AND l IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id) AS team_rates;

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id across all years and leagues, and each qualifying manager_half row contributes equally to its team's average.
